results.name: Logitech MX4 Black Ergonomic Mouse
results.description: High-quality, photo-realistic 3D model of a modern ergonomic wireless productivity mouse, designed specifically for professional workspace renderings, corporate office setups, and architectural visualization. Built with clean, subdivision-ready quad-based geometry, this asset ensures smooth shading and flawless edge tension under subdivision surface modifiers without deformation. The model features fully unwrapped, non-overlapping UV coordinates with optimized texel density and clean padding. Materials are configured for native Blender Cycles and EEVEE rendering, utilizing high-resolution PBR textures (Base Color, Roughness, Metallic, Normal, and Emissive) for realistic matte plastic, textured acoustic fabric, tactile rubber thumb rest grips, and metallic knurled scroll wheels. The scene is fully optimized, scaled to real-world metric dimensions (1:1), centered at origin (0,0,0) with cleared transforms, and contains no unnecessary lights or cameras.
